original_title: 君たちはどう生きるか
overview: While the Second World War rages, the teenage Mahito, haunted by his mother's tragic death, is relocated from Tokyo to the serene rural home of his new stepmother Natsuko, a woman who bears a striking resemblance to the boy's mother.  As he tries to adjust, this strange new world grows even stranger following the appearance of a persistent gray heron, who perplexes and bedevils Mahito, dubbing him the "long-awaited one."
tagline: Where death comes to an end, life finds a new beginning.
title: The Boy and the Heron

results.title: Ten Little Gall Force
results.original_title: テンリトルガルフォース
results.overview: A super deformed parody which depicts the "making of " Eternal Story and Destruction. A very humorous behind-the-scenes look (if "Gall Force" were a live-action series instead of being animated).

results.title: Love, Simon
results.overview: Everyone deserves a great love story, but for 17-year-old Simon Spier, it's a little more complicated. He hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online.

results.title: Silence Is Welcome
results.overview: During the holidays, Amanda, trapped in adolescence, looks for a way to escape from the annoying family trip. While travelling, she realizes how her relationship with her family is progressively crumbling and her parents marriage is slowly falling apart. She sees it as a punishment, but does not suspect that with the imminent escalation of violence in Mexico this could be their last vacation together.

results.title: No Nest
results.overview: Slavik is 17 years old, a gifted programmer who, despite the pressure from everyone around him, is doing his best to become independent by finding an acting course that is unlike anything he has done before.

results.title: Warriors of the Wind
results.overview: After a global war, the seaside kingdom known as the Valley of the Wind remains one of the last strongholds on Earth untouched by a poisonous jungle and the powerful insects that guard it. Led by the courageous Princess Nausicaä, the people of the Valley engage in an epic struggle to restore the bond between humanity and Earth.

results.title: Three Colors: Blue
results.overview: The wife of a famous composer survives a car accident that kills her husband and daughter. Now alone, she shakes off her old identity and explores her newfound freedom but finds that she is unbreakably bound to other humans, including her husband’s mistress, whose existence she never suspected.

results.title: The Lord of the Rings
results.overview: Young Hobbit Frodo Baggins is thrown into an amazing adventure when he's tasked with destroying the One Ring, created by the dark lord Sauron. Frodo must travel in a small fellowship of nine warriors and accomplices. But it won't be an easy journey for the Fellowship of the Ring, on the ultimate quest to rid Middle-earth of evil.

results.title: Space Man
results.overview: An agoraphobic man traps himself in an astronaut costume to avoid the disastrous consequences of his condition

results.title: Echo
results.overview: In this silent short film, we follow three stories grappling with grief. As the characters within these stories take action and process their feelings, we see the intertwining nature of these peoples lives.

results.title: Godzilla: Planet of the Monsters
results.overview: A desperate group of refugees attempts to recolonize Earth 20,000 years after Godzilla took over. But one young man wants revenge above all else.

results.title: An Evening
results.overview: Having slept together for the first time, two teenage boys must make sense of their evolving relationship.

results.title: Warriors of Horseshoe 3: Redemption
results.overview: After the death of his brother at the hands of the Master of Shaolin Horseshoes, an enraged hunter seeks a path of vengeance.

results.title: The Crossing I
results.overview: At the end of the World War II and the middle of the Chinese Revolution, three couples from different backgrounds with different nationalities flee from China to the island of Taiwan.

results.title: Drei Tage im April
results.overview: Shortly before the end of the war in 1945, the Allies can already be heard in Nesselbühl in Swabia when three freight cars are uncoupled at the station. The screams of the starving concentration camp prisoners inside can be heard throughout the village, but nobody dares to help them. Only the innkeeper's daughter Anna takes heart...

results.title: Oh, Let's Be Friends!
results.overview: Two distant friends, who both are pursuing careers in filmmaking, attempt to rekindle their friendship over a short camping trip.

results.title: Gone
results.overview: An 18-year-old boy feels pressured by everyone about his future. Wanting someone to listen, he thinks back to his childhood and drifts into his own thoughts. While talking to his younger self, he finally remembers something important that he had forgotten long ago.

results.title: Your Warmest
results.overview: Struggling through a trauma filled life, Lou seeks help from a therapist who practices an unusual supernatural healing technique.

results.title: Barton Fink
results.overview: A renowned New York playwright is enticed to California to write for the movies and discovers the hellish truth of Hollywood.

results.title: A River Runs Through It
results.overview: The Maclean brothers, Paul and Norman, live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister, the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess where they've been and where they're going.

results.title: Rome, Open City
results.overview: During the Nazi occupation of 1944 Rome, Resistance leader Giorgio Manfredi is pursued by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a means of escape.
